P01.rationale: A large portrait photo of a person occupies roughly the top-left quadrant of the page, serving as a strong human anchor, though it is a video-still crop rather than a formal portrait.

P05.rationale: The client (Conesso GmbH) is represented by a clearly framed, named portrait at meaningful size (roughly a third of the left column), with name and company label beneath it.

P07.rationale: There is no press/logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus visible on the page beyond a single pull-quote attribution.

P10.rationale: A large opening quotation mark glyph appears on the right column, but it is modest in scale and there are no giant ghost numerals or other oversized decorative typographic elements.

P11.rationale: Three bold before/after data points (50%, 4 Monate, 0) are displayed as large typographic statistics with supporting labels, functioning as real data-bound result callouts.

P12.rationale: The layout is reasonably well-filled with a large portrait, structured body copy sections, stat callouts, and a testimonial, giving a competent editorial density, though the right column has some open breathing room.

P13.rationale: A very subtle warm off-white/cream background tint is used, but there is no meaningful texture or atmospheric treatment beyond a flat tinted ground.

P14.rationale: The portrait photo is contained within a framed box with no text overlaid on the busy image area, so readability is not compromised; however, there is no full-bleed photo requiring a scrim treatment.

P16.rationale: No device mockup (phone, laptop, book, or similar product) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The portrait appears to be a video-still of a real person associated with the named client, but the casual, unbranded framing gives it a somewhat generic feel without clear business-specific context.

N08.rationale: The upper-right area around the circular graphic element has noticeable empty space, but overall the page is reasonably filled and the whitespace is mostly intentional breathing room rather than purposeless dead zones.

N10.rationale: No text is placed directly over the busy portrait photo; all copy sits on the clean background areas, so there are no legibility issues from text-on-photo conflicts.
